ownerSelectedScope: Smaller batches of genuinely new 3–6-letter words; no obscure filler to reach 100.
method: Exact-spelling deduplication against all content JSON and VOCABULARY review JSON/text, including rejected, skipped and unselected candidates. Individually checked proposed senses against linked sources.
limitations: The exact eight selected senses are approved and await integration; the active revision 30 remains unchanged.
The other 12 remain unapproved for required use, without an explicit all-gameplay exclusion. Do not propose any of the 20 spellings again as new.
No boards, campaign capacity or repetition benefits have been validated.
Preserve recorded senses: currency names, toasted bread, snack, pastry and Republic of the Congo; no broader proper-name or grammatical exceptions.
